comment: SHA-256 of the modern armour style's files: the geometry under armour_geo/, the textures under textures/models/armor/modern/, the icons under textures/item/modern/, their item models under models/item/modern/ and the OreSpawn Visuals pictures under textures/gui/visuals/; and of the horse and wolf armour's textures under textures/entity/horse/armor/ and textures/entity/wolf/armor/, their icons and their item models; and of the spears' textures and item models. "classic" pins the classic look: its textures and icons, and its item models without their one overrides entry. The asset audit compares every file with its pin; tools/armour/write_pins.py rewrites this list.
